content: Hello, I am Vector Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Alex Rowan?
Yes, this is Alex Rowan speaking.
Before we continue, I need to ask you two security questions. Could you please tell me your member code?
No, I will not provide the member code.
I need to confirm your identity before I can discuss anything with you; this protects your privacy. Could you please tell me your member code?
No, I still refuse the security check.
Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
